mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_python_practice_plan_question q JOIN biz_data_lab_snapshot d ON d.snapshot_id=q.snapshot_id WHERE q.plan_version_id=#{versionId} AND q.question_id=#{questionId}

SELECT d.*,s.question_id FROM biz_data_lab_snapshot d JOIN biz_python_practice_question_snapshot s ON s.snapshot_id=d.snapshot_id WHERE s.source_type='BASE_VERSION' AND s.source_id=#{versionId} AND s.question_id=#{questionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_data_lab_snapshot(snapshot_id,experiment_name,description,starter_code,excel_file_url,excel_file_name,excel_file_size,max_score) SELECT ns.snapshot_id,d.experiment_name,d.description,d.starter_code,d.excel_file_url,d.excel_file_name,d.excel_file_size,d.max_score FROM biz_python_practice_question_snapshot os JOIN biz_data_lab_snapshot d ON d.snapshot_id=os.snapshot_id JOIN biz_python_practice_question_snapshot ns ON ns.source_type='BASE_VERSION' AND ns.source_id=#{toVersionId} AND ns.question_id=os.question_id WHERE os.source_type='BASE_VERSION' AND os.source_id=#{fromVersionId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_data_lab_upload WHERE file_url=#{url} AND user_id=#{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE d FROM biz_data_lab_submission d JOIN biz_python_practice_plan_version v ON d.source_type='BASE_VERSION' AND d.source_id=v.plan_version_id WHERE v.plan_id=#{planId}

DELETE d FROM biz_data_lab_snapshot d JOIN biz_python_practice_question_snapshot s ON s.snapshot_id=d.snapshot_id JOIN biz_python_practice_plan_version v ON s.source_type='BASE_VERSION' AND s.source_id=v.plan_version_id WHERE v.plan_id=#{planId}
mapper.select: SELECT source_type,source_id,question_id,score best_score,'1' completed_flag, CASE WHEN score IS NULL THEN '1' ELSE '0' END pending_grading, CASE WHEN score=max_score THEN '1' ELSE '0' END passed_flag, revision submit_count,submitted_at last_practice_time FROM biz_data_lab_submission WHERE student_id=#{userId}
SELECT * FROM biz_data_lab_submission WHERE chart_image_url=#{resource} LIMIT 1

SELECT question_id, experiment_name, description, starter_code, excel_file_url, excel_file_name, excel_file_size, max_score, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time FROM biz_data_lab_config WHERE question_id = #{questionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_data_lab_config ( question_id, experiment_name, description, starter_code, excel_file_url, excel_file_name, excel_file_size, max_score, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time ) VALUES ( #{questionId}, #{experimentName}, #{description}, #{starterCode}, #{excelFileUrl}, #{excelFileName}, #{excelFileSize}, #{maxScore}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE experiment_name = VALUES(experiment_name), description = VALUES(description), starter_code = VALUES(starter_code), excel_file_url = VALUES(excel_file_url), excel_file_name = VALUES(excel_file_name), excel_file_size = VALUES(excel_file_size), max_score = VALUES(max_score), update_by = VALUES(update_by), update_time = VALUES(update_time)
mapper.select: SELECT s.*, u.nick_name AS student_name, u.user_name AS student_number FROM biz_data_lab_submission s LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = s.student_id WHERE s.submission_id = #{submissionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_data_lab_submission ( student_id, question_id, source_type, source_id, source_code, chart_image_url, output_text, submitted_at, max_score, revision ) VALUES ( #{studentId}, #{questionId}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{sourceCode}, #{chartImageUrl}, #{outputText}, #{submittedAt}, #{maxScore}, 1 ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE source_code = VALUES(source_code), chart_image_url = VALUES(chart_image_url), output_text = VALUES(output_text), submitted_at = VALUES(submitted_at), max_score = VALUES(max_score), revision = revision + 1, score = NULL, score_comment = NULL, scored_by = NULL, scored_at = NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE biz_data_lab_submission SET score = #{score}, score_comment = #{scoreComment}, scored_by = #{scoredBy}, scored_at = NOW() WHERE submission_id = #{submissionId} AND revision = #{revision}
